about: Real photos of nutrition labels from Open Food Facts (images CC BY-SA 3.0, attribution: Open Food Facts contributors and the product page). Each photo is the contributor's selected nutrition crop, downscaled to a long edge of at most 1,600 px. Every figure under columns was read by eye from the photo (lane RB-M1, 18 Nov 2026); a figure that could not be read is listed under unscored and left out. The OFF structured record was a cross-check only: it disagreed with the photo on several labels (older recipes) and the photo wins.
